title: Users may be unable to access tabs beyond the Conversation tab in certain Microsoft Teams channels
impact: Users may have been unable to access tabs beyond the Conversation tab in certain Microsoft Teams channels.

updates.content:
Title: Users may be unable to access tabs beyond the Conversation tab in certain Microsoft Teams channels

User impact: Users may be unable to access tabs beyond the Conversation tab in certain Microsoft Teams channels.

More info: Users may only see the Conversation tab in Microsoft Teams channels when channel names and associated sensitivity labels are long, particularly on smaller displays. As a result, other tabs such as Shared, Files, Notes, and custom tabs may not be visible.

As a workaround, impacted users can zoom out in Teams, use a larger display where available, or, in some cases, select the overflow arrow to access hidden tabs.

Current status: We're reviewing HTTP Archive (HAR) files and Teams client logs from a number of impacted users to determine the root cause and identify mitigation options.

Scope of impact: Any user attempting to access tabs beyond the Conversation tab in Microsoft Teams channels with long channel names and/or associated sensitivity labels may be impacted.

Next update by: Thursday, September 3, 2026, at 11:00 AM UTC
